label: haplotype regimes — Stage 4 bruteforce projection
legacy_source: n/a — this page was new in v3.4 (not in legacy/Inversion_atlas.html)
purpose: Long-range haplotype regimes. Wires the v3.4 banding pipeline (Stage 1 seed discovery + Stage 2 cross-seed voting + Stage 3 chain walk + Stage 4 bruteforce projection) into the atlas-core shell. 2×2 panel grid: chrom-scope and genome-scope versions of target-band lanes and PC1 lines. Action bar exposes 'run pipeline' and 'export catalogue' buttons.

panels.purpose: target-band lanes panel at chromosome scope
PC1 lines at chromosome scope (per-sample lines coloured by voter band)
target-band lanes at genome scope (toggled via 'g' key)
run pipeline button + export catalogue button + focal-voter controls

subdir_files: regimes_page.js — page wrapper (4 panels in 2×2 grid + header)
regimes_panel.js — target-band lanes panel, scope-aware (chrom default, genome opt-in)
regimes_pc1_panel.js — PC1-lines variant; same focal-voter logic, y-axis = PC1 from upstream local PCA
primitives_used: shared/per_l2_cluster.js (contextFromState, ClusterCache) — per-window K-means labels cached
shared/band_tracking/dosage_overlay.js — HOM_REF/HET/HOM_INV classifier for the dosage tint
adapters_used: ClusterCache pattern (per_l2_cluster.js) — bridges atlas-side state to pipeline ctx

interactions.purpose: getMacroDosage(locus, sample_set) — provided by host; panels don't talk to dosage server directly

computed_preview_outputs: Stage 4 voteRecords + consensus_partition per target locus
pattern_class per voter→target pair (SINGLE / SUBSET / SPLIT_TWO / SUBSET_SPLIT / COHERENT_SPLIT / RANDOM_FAN / SCATTER / EMPTY)
consensus class per target (CLEAN_PARTITION / SOFT_PARTITION / AMBIGUOUS_BAND / OVERLAPPING_VOTES / MULTI_LAYER_STRUCTURE / NO_CLEAN_CONSENSUS)
dosage class per macro-band (HOM_REF / HET / HOM_INV / AMBIGUOUS_DOSAGE / NO_SAMPLES)
committable_outputs: regime catalogue JSON (cohort-level, deterministic key: interval_id × cohort_id × reference_id × pipeline_version × knob_hash)
downstream: stage3_loci promotable into state.candidateList (per HANDOFF_2026-05-14_seeds_to_candidates_wiring; not yet wired)
three_cohort_discipline: cohort_id + reference_id tagged from active dataset; catalogue does NOT aggregate across reference assemblies (F1 hybrid ≠ 226 pure C.gariepinus ≠ wild C.macrocephalus)

bundle_meta_docs: specs_done/_bundles/HOW_TO_USE_haplotype_regimes.md (user guide — the ONLY end-user docs for any page right now)

known_issues: Phase 1 only: LG28 → LG28 (per-chromosome). Genome-wide projection (Phase 2/3) requires chromosomes manifest + registry-cached catalogue.
stage3.loci → state.candidateList wiring is the seeds_to_candidates_wiring HANDOFF — not yet implemented; promote step is manual.
Annotation layer (SPEC_regime_annotation_v34), copy-origin painting (SPEC_copy_origin_painting), and fish ancestry scroller (SPEC_fish_ancestry_scroller) are all SPEC ONLY per their status lines.
